stories.title: Vliegtuig naar Israël maakt noodlanding in Saoedi-Arabië: mogelijk gevecht in cockpit, toestel maakte duikvlucht

en.title: Plane to Israel makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia: possible cockpit fight, aircraft made dive
en.summary: An aircraft heading to Israel executed an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia after reportedly experiencing a possible altercation in the cockpit and performing a steep dive.

stories.title: Live mogelijke kaping | Vliegtuig richting Tel Aviv maakte enorme duikvlucht

en.title: Live possible hijacking | Plane heading to Tel Aviv made enormous dive
en.summary: A flight bound for Tel Aviv experienced a serious dive and was subject to a stabbing incident in the cockpit, with live updates being provided on developments.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, burgemeester van Marrakech, wordt de eerste vrouwelijke premier van Marokko

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, mayor of Marrakech, becomes first female prime minister of Morocco
en.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, who previously served as mayor of Marrakech, has been appointed as Morocco's first female prime minister.

stories.title: Netanyahu geeft vage waarschuwingen over aanvallen in aanloop naar verkiezingen, oppositie spreekt over angstzaaierij

en.title: Netanyahu issues vague warnings about attacks ahead of elections, opposition speaks of fearmongering
en.summary: Netanyahu made ambiguous warnings regarding potential attacks in the period leading up to elections, while opposition figures accused him of using fear tactics.

stories.title: Politie arresteert twee mannen uit Amsterdam in onderzoek naar geweld Overasselt

en.title: Police arrest two men from Amsterdam in investigation into Overasselt violence
en.summary: Two men aged 24 and 25 from Amsterdam have been arrested as suspects in connection with violence in Overasselt. A 19-year-old man was also detained while authorities continue investigating his involvement.

stories.title: Opnieuw verdachten aangehouden in onderzoek naar geweld Overasselt

en.title: New suspects arrested in investigation into Overasselt violence
en.summary: Police arrested two men aged 24 and 25 from Amsterdam on Monday in connection with violence in Overasselt. Searches in three cities resulted in the seizure of two firearms, including one automatic weapon, and the detention of a 19-year-old man.

stories.title: Vliegtuig op weg naar Israël maakt duikvlucht na gevecht in cockpit

en.title: Aircraft heading to Israel makes dive after cockpit fight
en.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv encountered a disturbance when one pilot allegedly attempted to crash the plane and stabbed his colleague. The attacker was overpowered before the aircraft could be compromised.

stories.title: Nieuwe aanhoudingen in onderzoek Overasselt, opnieuw vuurwapens gevonden

en.title: New arrests in Overasselt investigation, firearms found again
en.summary: Three additional suspects were arrested on Monday in connection with a violent incident that occurred in early month in the Gelderland municipality of Overasselt.

stories.title: Elk uur dat bedrijven stilliggen door waarschuwing voor Russische luchtaanvallen kost Oekraïne 40 miljoen euro

en.title: Each hour companies stand still due to warning for Russian air attacks costs Ukraine 40 million euros
en.summary: Ukrainian businesses face significant economic losses during air raid warnings triggered by Russian attacks, with hourly costs reaching 40 million euros as operations halt across the country.

stories.title: Netanyahu klaagt media aan die berichtten over waarschuwingen voor 7 oktober

en.title: Netanyahu sues media outlets that reported on warnings before October 7
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu filed defamation suits against three media companies and six journalists after reports emerged that he had received personal warnings about the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack but did not share them with security officials.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri wordt de eerste vrouwelijke premier van Marokko

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes Morocco's first female prime minister
en.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, the mayor of Marrakech, has been appointed as Morocco's new prime minister and will form a government during a period of significant political unrest.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri wordt eerste vrouwelijke premier van Marokko

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes first female prime minister of Morocco
en.summary: The royal palace announced that Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri has been appointed as Morocco's new prime minister, marking the first time a woman holds this position.
